spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/outdoor-store/issues/12. Source revision: 2026-03-02T09:14:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Multi-target the domain library
tasks.body:
Convert `src/Contoso.Outdoor.Domain` to an SDK-style project targeting net48 and net10.0 so the legacy and new hosts share PriceCalculator.

## Acceptance criteria
- The legacy solution still builds and its tests pass on Windows.
- The domain library builds for net10.0 on Linux.
- No pricing behavior changes.

tasks.title: Create the ASP.NET Core host with YARP fallback
tasks.body:
Add `src/Contoso.Outdoor.Web.Core` (.NET 10) with System.Web adapters and a YARP catch-all that forwards every route to the legacy app, sharing its `.Outdoor.Auth` cookie and session.

## Acceptance criteria
- Every legacy route answers through the new host with the same status and content.
- A signed-in shopper stays signed in across both apps.
- A health endpoint returns 200.

tasks.title: Map the catalog schema with EF Core 10
tasks.body:
Add `src/Contoso.Outdoor.Data.Core` with an EF Core 10 context for products and categories, mapped explicitly to the existing tables.

## Acceptance criteria
- Integration tests return the same products and prices as the EF6 context for the same data.
- No migration is added.
- Connections use managed identity in Azure.

tasks.title: Containerise and provision the new host
tasks.body:
Add the Dockerfile, `azure.yaml` and Bicep for Container Apps, Container Registry, Key Vault and managed identity, plus a deploy workflow using OIDC.

## Acceptance criteria
- `azd provision --preview` shows only the intended resources.
- The image builds and answers its health endpoint.
- No secret is committed or stored as a workflow secret for Azure sign-in.

tasks.title: Port the catalog and product routes
tasks.body:
Port CatalogController and ProductController with their views to the new host; YARP stops forwarding exactly these routes.

## Acceptance criteria
- `/catalog` and `/p/{slug}` return the same URLs, status codes, prices and visible content as the legacy app.
- All other routes are still forwarded.
- Tests cover a found product, an unknown slug and a discounted price.
